note: Both halves of the note. Lost Success: the peer does not conclude before it, discards strays, concludes on the late Success. Lost Failure (TestRFC3748PeerConcludesFailureWithoutTheFailurePacket): after the MS-CHAPv2 failure indication is acknowledged and the EAP-Failure is dropped, a forged EAP-Success or a stray Request ends with ErrEAPFailure, not Done, no MSK, no Response; the producer parks pendingErr in handleMSCHAPv2Failure, and without it the forged Success would be silently discarded and the test fails. Every tagged unit carries a record.
